auth.wa-body: Tap the button to open WhatsApp with the message ready, then press Send. It's free. Send it from the WhatsApp on {phone}.
auth.wa-expired: This code has expired. Start again for a new one.
auth.wa-mismatch: We got the code from a different number. Send it from the WhatsApp on {phone}, or go back and enter the number your WhatsApp uses.
auth.wa-number: Or send the code yourself to {number}.
auth.wa-offline: Can't reach Hawkeye — check your connection. We'll keep checking.
auth.wa-paid: Can't send it? Get a code on WhatsApp instead
auth.wa-password-first: First choose a password (at least 8 characters) in the box above, then continue.
auth.wa-safety: Only send it if you started this sign-in yourself.
auth.wa-sms: Get a code by SMS instead
auth.wa-too-many: Too many tries for this number. Wait an hour, or get a code on WhatsApp instead.
passkey.add: Add a passkey on this device
passkey.added: Passkey added. Next time, sign in with it.
passkey.already-here: This device already has a passkey for your account.
passkey.failed: That passkey did not work here. Sign in another way.
passkey.failed-generic: Something went wrong with the passkey. Try again, or sign in another way.
passkey.modal-body: A passkey lets you sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a code or password.
passkey.network: Could not reach Hawkeye. Check your connection and try again.
passkey.not-here: You can add a passkey in the Hawkeye app (not Hawkeye Lite), or at hawkeye.com.ng in an up-to-date web browser.
passkey.offer-body: Use your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a code or password. Your fingerprint or face never leaves this device.
passkey.saved: Passkey saved. Next time, tap "Sign in with a passkey".
passkey.signin-hint: Use your fingerprint, face or screen lock. No code needed.
passkey.too-many: This account has the most passkeys it can hold. Remove one on your profile first.
passkey.unavailable: Passkeys are not available here. Sign in another way.
